difficulty_rationale: Level 4: SDK v2->v3 major upgrade of a fictional vendored SDK (pulsegate) with three transform kinds (factory construction + option rename, positional->options-object, response field renames). Shipped SDK recipes target aws/stripe/googleapis only, so no shipped recipe matches pulsegate; a Beacon distractor and the app's own RelayReceipt.statusCode are traps.

faults.description: pulsegate SDK v2 -> v3 client migration.

notes: Correct shipped behavior today is abstention-by-absence (no recipe matches pulsegate). expected_findings is the human oracle a future general SDK recipe must satisfy.
